findings.claim: The diff edits frontend/e2e-components/app-header.spec.ts, which the touch-point list does not name, and rewrites the SPEC-CORE-099 I13 assertion from 'sort at the header's right end' to 'sort at the content's start' on 375px shelf pages, while the spec's Revises section does not revise SPEC-CORE-099 I13.
findings.impact: On a phone, every listing-mode Video/Reading See all page now draws the sort at the left under the name field. This contradicts the implemented SPEC-CORE-099 I13 ('on the header's last row at its right end'), which still stands unrevised in docs/specs/addon-app-header.md:334-336. The only test that guarded that invariant was changed to match the new placement, so nothing now checks SPEC-CORE-099 I13 as written for those pages. Non-listing shelf pages keep the old placement, so one implemented invariant now holds on some shelf pages and not on others.
findings.evidence: frontend/e2e-components/app-header.spec.ts:196,206 (diff): the test title changed to 'at its start' and the assertion changed to `Math.abs(sort.left - m.contentLeft) <= 1`. The cause is frontend/src/components/videoapp/VideoShelfPage.tsx:315 and frontend/src/components/readingapp/ReadingShelfPage.tsx:274: in listing mode `actions` is a `flex-col items-start` wrapper below sm. docs/specs/addon-app-header.md:334-336 still says right end. app-library-name-filter.md 'Revises' lists SPEC-CORE-147 I10/I5/I12, SPEC-CORE-145 I11/I14 and SPEC-CORE-063 I16b, but not SPEC-CORE-099 I13. Touch points list neither app-header.spec.ts nor addon-app-header.md.
findings.repro: Static reading: compare the app-header.spec.ts hunk with addon-app-header.md:334 and the spec's Revises list. Mutation: restoring the old assertion (svg right edge == contentRight) would fail against the new listing-mode wrapper.

bucket_proposal.reason: The design deliberately moves the sort to the start (§1 'Field width', PhoneSeeAll) but neither declares the revision of the implemented SPEC-CORE-099 I13 nor lists the test it rewrites. The spec set now contradicts itself; no SPEC-CORE-156 invariant is broken.

findings.proposed_fix: Add 'SPEC-CORE-099 I13' to the Revises section, worded for listing-mode shelf pages: below 640px the sort is on its own line under the name field, at the start. List frontend/e2e-components/app-header.spec.ts in the touch points.

Clips' Target choice deletes q in the replace (clips.tsx:283) and in effectiveParams (clips.tsx:173). A Home-shortcut landing on another Target strips q through targetApplied → effectiveParams → fillHref, consistent with I6 as revised.
potential_unspecified_behavior: On phone-width listing-mode See all pages the sort moves from the header's right end to the start of its own row. This contradicts SPEC-CORE-099 I13, which the spec does not revise (F1). Non-listing shelf pages keep the right-end placement.

Clips: the q normalisation effect (clips.tsx:197-205) and the fillHref replace (clips.tsx:363-371) can both fire on one render when q is untrimmed and group/sort are missing. The last replace wins, and both carry the normalised q, so the end URL looks right, but two replaces are issued.
regression_risks: SPEC-CORE-099 I13 now holds only for non-listing shelf pages, and its e2e guard was rewritten, so a later change to the header's phone layout has no test pinning the original right-end rule.
ime-enter-guard.test.ts has a hard-coded count (21); any other branch that adds an Enter handler will conflict on this number at merge.
test_coverage: The app-header.spec.ts change covers only the listing-mode placement. No test asserts where the sort sits on a non-listing shelf page at 375px after this change.
ClipShelfBlock's FilteredEmpty is exercised through clipsNameFilter.test.tsx (I9, Library and folder shelf page).
The Home-shortcut I4 cases for Video/Reading are in appTargetParam.test.tsx; the Clips counterpart is in clipsNameFilter.test.tsx (I6 drop/keep after a landing).
